'''''Koh-Lanta: Le Choc des Héros''''' is the second special season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'', and the eleventh season overall. It was broadcast on TF1 from March 23 to May 21, 2010, with each episode airing at 6:55&nbsp;p.m.

[[Grégoire Delachaux]] defeated [[Freddy Boucher]] in a 6-2 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

== Production ==
This season took place on the island of Poum within New Caledonia.

==Twists==
* '''Reduced Cast:''' Unlike all previous seasons, each of which initially featured 16 castaways, this season initially featured 12.
*'''Newbies vs. Veterans:''' This season's initial cast consisted of a [[tribe]] of six former castaways competing against a tribe of six famous French athletes.
* '''New Tribe Members:''' On Day 4, former castaway [[Mohamed Derradji]] and athlete [[Taïg Khris]] entered the game.
*'''Final''' '''Five:''' Instead of occurring at the final four, the standard orienteering challenge occurred at the final five, with the two losers being eliminated.
